FIELDS.NAME: Stitch & Style Tailors
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Stitch & Style Tailors specializes in providing custom garment creation, alterations, and minor repairs for individual clients. Our operations include personalized fittings by appointment, ensuring a controlled customer flow and minimizing liability risks. We focus on high-quality craftsmanship in tailoring services, including bespoke menswear, formalwear, and clothing adjustments. Our boutique environment allows us to manage our inventory effectively, particularly during special events like weddings. We do not engage in full-scale manufacturing or hazardous chemical operations, maintaining compliance with safety standards. With a small and experienced team, we emphasize customer service and satisfaction while mitigating risks associated with higher volume tailoring businesses.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any self-service or attended coin-operated laundries and confirms that industrial and power laundries are not part of our operations. Additionally, we do not operate any rug cleaning plants and we do not use hazardous chemicals for on-premises dry cleaning. Our commitment to compliance ensures we meet all insurance requirements.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 5, 2023, a client reported a minor injury while trying on a garment in our fitting area, resulting in a settlement of $1,500. The claim has been resolved and is now closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 4:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: High-security safe for storing cash, sensitive documents, and valuables, Class B, UL listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security guard services during business hours.

FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Stitch & Style Tailors is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our focus is solely on providing tailoring services, alterations, and custom garment creation for individual clients.

FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Stitch & Style Tailors does not have any catastrophe exposure, as its operations focus on tailoring and do not involve high-risk activities or environments prone to such events.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Stitch & Style Tailors has not experienced any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse, molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business maintains a strong commitment to compliance and ethical practices.
